operator_brain_boundary.purpose: Keep trading-experiment changes separate from operational hardening while current-candidate paper evidence is being collected.

trading_brain.definition: The decision and strategy layer that changes market selection, sleeve parameters, signal thresholds, entry and exit logic, sizing, promotion criteria, or profitability evidence semantics.

categories.label: Market Decision
categories.purpose: Interprets market regime, symbol opportunity, sleeve priority, signal confidence, and where the platform thinks money may be moving.

categories.label: Strategy Logic
categories.purpose: Owns entries, exits, thresholds, feature weights, model choice, sleeve-specific parameters, and decision formulas.

categories.label: Risk and Execution Policy
categories.purpose: Controls sizing, paper execution admission, live authority, loss recovery limits, spread controls, quote age controls, and escalation gates.

categories.label: Candidate Evidence
categories.purpose: Protects current candidate identity, post-cost observations, observed days, independent fills, and promotion proof semantics.

ops_brain.definition: The runtime, storage, data freshness, queue, writer, reporting, notification, recovery, and observability layer that keeps the platform healthy without changing trade logic or execution authority.

owned_decisions: which queues or writers need guarded drain
which reports should surface operator needs

categories.label: Storage and Runtime
categories.purpose: Keeps disk, BOT_LOGS, SQLite/WAL files, retention, and local runtime pressure inside safe operating bounds.

categories.label: Writer and Queue
categories.purpose: Maintains single-writer safety, queue backpressure, lock health, drainers, and handoff plumbing.

categories.label: Data Freshness
categories.purpose: Refreshes feed state, source receipts, market context artifacts, and stale health artifacts without inventing source truth.

categories.label: Observability and Reporting
categories.purpose: Improves operator reports, daily notifications, handoff artifacts, dashboards, needs statements, and communication clarity.

categories.label: Process Recovery
categories.purpose: Supervises watchdogs, launchd jobs, guarded restarts, failure recovery, and resource-pressure relief.

routing_matrix.classification_rule: Classify each operator request by brain and category before changing files or running operational commands.

handoff_language.summary: Trading Brain is frozen except bug fixes; Ops Brain can keep being hardened.
handoff_language.trading_freeze_reason: Current candidate profitability evidence needs a stable decision surface across post-cost samples and observed days.
handoff_language.safe_work_now: storage, writer locks, feed freshness, queue pressure, reports, notifications, artifact consistency, and watchdog recovery
handoff_language.frozen_work_now: sleeve parameters, entry and exit logic, signal thresholds, sizing, candidate identity, promotion gates, and live authority

roles.purpose: Acquire, timestamp, validate, and append source observations with provenance.
Normalize and synchronize macro, micro, event, regime, and market context without creating order authority.
Produce scored, attributable market hypotheses within a declared sleeve and regime mandate.
Aggregate specialized strategy evidence within one mandate and emit bounded order intentions.
Rank sleeves and coordinate shadow or paper recommendations without bypassing governance.
Coordinate global policy, resource allocation, and cross-sleeve priorities without granting execution authority.
Apply non-bypassable limits, approve or veto intentions, and fail closed on ambiguous risk state.
Evaluate candidate evidence and record promotion state while preserving explicit human live approval.
Consume approved paper intentions and produce simulated broker-faithful executions.
Act as the sole live order writer after every candidate, risk, account, and allowlist gate clears.
Record append-only execution facts and reconcile broker, account, position, and fill state.
Maintain runtime, storage, freshness, and process health through bounded, auditable repairs.
Render canonical facts and grades without mutating the facts being reported.
Train and evaluate candidate models under single-flight, resource, lineage, and holdout controls.
Validate organization, evidence, capabilities, authority, and model quality without granting execution.
